Subject: HiveMetrics - Redwood demo request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick intro — we'd love to get a focused demo of Redwood next week. Would 10:00 AM PT on Monday, May 10 work for your team? We expect 6 people from Product and Infra: Natalie Pierce (Head of Product), myself, and a couple of ops folks. High-level goals: lower per-token serving costs, predictable p95 latency, and a path to dedicated capacity if the pilot goes well.

Agenda: short overview (10m), technical walk (30m), rollout/questions (20m).

I've attached a brief scope doc (hivemetrics-goals.docx) and our Calendly if you want to propose a different slot: https://calendly.com/hivemetrics/demo

Appreciate it —
Alex

Head of Product, HiveMetrics

- Move the live demo to Tuesday May 12 at 11:00 AM PT (Karthik is back and available)
- Keep the May 10 slot and have Marissa run the demo, with a short recorded deep-dive from Karthik to play during the technical section; Karthik would join live for Q&A if his schedule allows.

If you prefer the earlier slot, we can do the recording+live Q&A hybrid. Marissa, can you cover a 30–40m technical demo if needed?

I put a draft mutual action plan in our shared Drive — will send the link in the next email once you confirm a time.

Best,
